sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "remote_id" TEXT NULL, "semester" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "last_seen_at" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("remote_id", "semester"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "class_slots" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "course_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "online" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("online" IN (0, 1)), "repeat_rule" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_weekday" INTEGER NULL, "imported_start_min" INTEGER NULL, "imported_end_min" INTEGER NULL, "imported_place" TEXT NULL, "place_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("place_edited" IN (0, 1)), "online_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("online_edited" IN (0, 1)), "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "recorded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("recorded" IN (0, 1)), CHECK ("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK ("start_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK ("end_min" > "start_min" AND "end_min" < "start_min" + 1440), CHECK ("recorded" = 0 OR "online" = 1), CHECK ("imported_weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK ("imported_start_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK ("imported_end_min" > "imported_start_min" AND "imported_end_min" < "imported_start_min" + 1440), CHECK (("imported_weekday" IS NULL) = ("imported_start_min" IS NULL) AND ("imported_start_min" IS NULL) = ("imported_end_min" IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "class_exceptions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "class_slot_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES class_slots (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_min" INTEGER NULL, "end_min" INTEGER NULL, CHECK ("start_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK ("end_min" > "start_min" AND "end_min" < "start_min" + 1440), CHECK (("start_min" IS NULL) = ("end_min" IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fixed_blocks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "buffer_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "prep" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, CHECK (json_valid("weekdays") AND json_type("weekdays") = 'array'), CHECK ("start_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK ("end_min" > "start_min" AND "end_min" < "start_min" + 1440), CHECK ("buffer_min" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "place" TEXT NULL, "prep" TEXT NULL, "reminder_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (julianday("end_at") >= julianday("start_at")));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lms_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "course_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "course_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NULL, "due_time_unknown" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("due_time_unknown" IN (0, 1)), "open_at" TEXT NULL, "video_min" INTEGER NULL, "required_min" INTEGER NULL, "watched_min" INTEGER NULL, "officially_done" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("officially_done" IN (0, 1)), "submitted" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("submitted" IN (0, 1)), "link" TEXT NULL, "first_seen_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "miss_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gone_at" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK ("miss_count" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NULL, "due_time_unknown" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("due_time_unknown" IN (0, 1)), "estimate_min" INTEGER NULL, "spent_min" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "lms_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES lms_items (remote_key), "course_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "source" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "actual_min" INTEGER NULL, "partial_goal_min" INTEGER NULL, "night_window_from" TEXT NULL, "deferred_until" TEXT NULL, CHECK ("actual_min" IS NULL OR "actual_min" >= 0), CHECK ("partial_goal_min" IS NULL OR "partial_goal_min" > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_blocks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "start_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "answered_at" TEXT NULL, "from_briefing" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("from_briefing" IN (0, 1)), CHECK (julianday("end_at") >= julianday("start_at")));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "params" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "sentence" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lms_item_changes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_value" TEXT NULL, "new_value" TEXT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "briefings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" TEXT NULL, "confirmed_at" TEXT NULL, "edit_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK ("edit_count" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_runs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "failed_course_ids" TEXT NULL, "elapsed_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_lease" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "holder" TEXT NOT NULL, "token" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ("id" = 1)) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "undo_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" INTEGER NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ("id" = 1)) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS class_exceptions_slot_date ON class_exceptions (class_slot_id, date)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS plan_blocks_task_id ON plan_blocks (task_id)
